levels.label: Exemplary
levels.descriptor: Clear thesis, evidence throughout, no mechanical errors that impede meaning.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Clear thesis with mostly relevant support; minor mechanical errors.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Thesis present but thinly supported; errors distract in places.

levels.label: Beginning
levels.descriptor: No clear thesis; support is missing or off-topic.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Audible, well paced, holds eye contact, answers questions confidently.

levels.label: Very good
levels.descriptor: Clear delivery with occasional reliance on notes.

levels.label: Satisfactory
levels.descriptor: Understandable but read largely from notes.

levels.label: Needs practice
levels.descriptor: Hard to hear; content out of order.

levels.label: Independent
levels.descriptor: Follows the procedure and records observations without prompting.

levels.label: Guided
levels.descriptor: Completes the procedure with occasional reminders.

messageTemplates.name: Absence follow-up
messageTemplates.text: Good day, {{guardian}}. This is to inform you that {{first_name}} was marked absent today. Kindly let us know if there is anything we should be aware of. Thank you.

messageTemplates.name: Positive note home
messageTemplates.text: Good day, {{guardian}}! I wanted to share that {{first_name}} did excellent work in class today. Thank you for your support at home.

messageTemplates.name: Missing requirement
messageTemplates.text: Good day, {{guardian}}. {{first_name}} has an outstanding requirement in Science. May we ask for your help in following this up? Thank you.

messageTemplates.name: Parent conference invite
messageTemplates.text: Good day, {{guardian}}. May we invite you for a short conference regarding {{first_name}}. Please let us know a convenient schedule this week.

messageTemplates.name: Grade update
messageTemplates.text: Good day, {{guardian}}. {{first_name}} currently has a grade of {{grade}} in Science for this quarter. Please feel free to reach out with any questions.
